Emily Redwood <emily.redwood@curtin.edu.au>:
Hi Sara, Thank you for your email. My research team is currently exploring apps for patient reported outcome measures for an upcoming researcher-led clinical trial. Sara Farnya <sales@avicennaresearch.com>:
Hi Emily,I hope you are doing well.Thank you for reaching out and considering our platform for your clinical trial. I would be more than happy to help you with your questions.Data Security: Our services are compliant with GDPR, PIPEDA, HIPAA, FDA CFR Part 11, and ISO 27001 standards and regulations. The data is stored on our secure servers in Canada. However, please note that this is the default setting. We also offer on-premises deployment in which we completely deploy our service on your local machines or any cloud solution that you want. The data will be anonymized and encrypted on phones moments after the data collection and will be sent to our/your servers every hour, depending on the quality/security of the internet connection. The data remains encrypted during the transfer and will be instantly removed from phones right after the upload. On the other side, only researchers have access to the collected data. We also support Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for researchers. If you need, I can share more details about our infrastructure as well. Regardless, please rest assured that your data is safe with us, otherwise, we wouldn't be able to work with governments, including ACT Health, and other well-known institutions around the world. Data Output:While the specific data output can indeed vary depending on the trial's setup, we typically provide output in CSV format. Additionally, we can customize reports to include the specific metrics and visuals your team needs. I have attached a sample GPS (location) data output for your review. Integration with RedCap: Currently, the collected data isn't exportable in RedCap-compatible formats. However, we can integrate our platform with RedCap if necessary. Feel free to let me know if there are other questions I can assist with. We are always available for a quick chat and would love to learn more about your project. Our calendar is shared here for your convenience. Best,Sara--Avicenna Research Inc.4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada Email: sales@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com-- On Tuesday, November 12, 2024 at 5:07:33 AM,
